title: Callbacks: Early Stopping & Checkpoints 🚦
description: Automate training with callbacks – stop early, save best model, adjust rates.

slides.title: What are Callbacks? 📞
slides.content:
# Functions Called at Training Milestones

Callbacks let you hook into events like `on_epoch_end` to perform actions:
- Save model checkpoints.
- Stop training early.
- Adjust learning rate.
- Log to TensorBoard.

Pass a list to `model.fit(callbacks=[...])`.

slides.title: EarlyStopping – The Must‑Have 🛑
slides.content: Stop training when a monitored metric stops improving.
slides.codeSnippet:
early_stop = tf.keras.callbacks.EarlyStopping(
    monitor='val_loss',
    patience=3,          # epochs to wait
    restore_best_weights=True
)

model.fit(X, y, epochs=100, callbacks=[early_stop], validation_split=0.2)

quizData.question: What does `patience=5` in EarlyStopping mean?

options.text: Wait 5 epochs of no improvement before stopping

quizData.explanation: Patience is the number of epochs without improvement after which training will be stopped.

slides.title: ModelCheckpoint – Save the Best 💾
slides.content:
# Preserve Your Best Model

```python
checkpoint = tf.keras.callbacks.ModelCheckpoint(
    'best_model.h5',
    monitor='val_accuracy',
    save_best_only=True,
    mode='max'
)
```

After training, load with `tf.keras.models.load_model('best_model.h5')`.

slides.title: Learning Rate Scheduler
slides.codeSnippet:
reduce_lr = tf.keras.callbacks.ReduceLROnPlateau(
    monitor='val_loss',
    factor=0.2,
    patience=2,
    min_lr=0.0001
)

model.fit(..., callbacks=[reduce_lr])

slides.title: Combine Callbacks 🧰
slides.content: You can pass multiple callbacks: `callbacks=[early_stop, checkpoint, tensorboard]`. They work harmoniously.

slides.title: Try It 🛠️
slides.content: Train a small model and use EarlyStopping with `patience=2` and ModelCheckpoint to save the best weights. Observe how the training stops earlier than the `epochs` parameter.
